card.name: Mixing and preparation step instructions
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words just before the next preparation action, such as mixing, stirring, shaking or pressing, in step-by-step directions for opening capsules, dissolving tablets or giving a dose.

modes.label: Capsule into applesauce
modes.description: Comma, period or verb right after emptying capsule contents onto applesauce or yogurt, before the mixing step.

modes.label: Gentle mixing manner
modes.description: Words describing how to mix or dissolve, such as gently or without crushing.

modes.description: The period after a step number or letter, just before the next action.
